title: Pentel Orenz Nero Mechanical Pencil 0.3mm
description_en: The all-black Pentel Orenz Nero features an auto-advance mechanism that eliminates lead breakage forever. Beloved by architects and draftspeople for its precision and 0.3mm ultra-fine line.
description_ja: 芯が折れない自動繰り出し機構を搭載した全黒のOrenz Nero。建築家や製図士に愛用される0.3mm極細シャープペン。
